narr: Scattered thunderstorms moved west across southeast Arizona during the afternoon and evening. Thunderstorm wind gusts downed power poles in Catalina, Kearny and Vail while flash flooding occurred in Nogales and Tucson.
ev: One to two inches of rain in less than an hour in Nogales, Sonora caused a rapid rise on Nogales Wash in Arizona, causing it to overtop its banks. Two drowning victims were washed across the border from Mexico and retrieved in Arizona.
More than 1 of rain in less than 1 hour in Vail caused flash flooding of roadways including Old Vail Rd. and Dawn Rd.
